overseer.name: Ethrak Ostkad
notes: It means to lay the fortress out as a great hall with rooms off it.
Struck the earth: a stair down 3 levels, farms and a stockpile by the wagon.
Uneasy, it saw the fortress short of stone: had a storeroom quarried out.
Uneasy, it saw the fortress short of seeds: set farmers to gather what grows wild.
Hung a gate at the foot of the stair, to bar when enemies come.
